# Lembaran
> Brankas Aksara Personal yang Berdikari — v3.3.0 (Update 22/02/2026)

## Tentang Proyek
Lembaran adalah aplikasi manajemen catatan lokal-first dengan enkripsi end-to-end (AES-GCM + Argon2id). Tidak ada server pihak ketiga — data tersimpan sepenuhnya di perangkat pengguna.

## Struktur Monorepo
```
packages/
  core/   — Shared logic: enkripsi, storage adapter, AI, Sentinel
  cli/    — Terminal interface (TUI) berbasis Bun & Ink (PilihanModern kustom untuk unlooping)
  web/    — Next.js 16 app (App Router + Turbopack)
```

## Arsitektur Web (packages/web)
- **Framework**: Next.js 16.1.6, React 19, Turbopack
- **Routing URL**: `app/[locale]/` → semua halaman diprefix `/id/` atau `/en/`
- **i18n**: `next-intl` — locale berbasis URL, bukan state
  - `i18n/routing.ts` — config locale (`id` default, `en`)
  - `i18n/request.ts` — server config, load messages JSON
  - `i18n/navigation.ts` — locale-aware `Link`, `useRouter`, `usePathname`
  - `middleware.ts` — auto-redirect ke locale prefix
  - `messages/id.json`, `messages/en.json` — kamus terjemahan UI
- **State management**: Zustand via `@lembaran/core/Pundi`
- **Storage**: IndexedDB (browser) via `BrowserAdapter`, JSON file (Node) via `FileAdapter`

## Arsitektur Core (packages/core)
- `Arsip.ts` — CRUD catatan tingkat tinggi
- `Brankas.ts` — Mesin kriptografi (AES-GCM, Argon2id)
- `Gudang.ts` — Storage abstraction (auto-detect browser vs Node)
- `Sentinel.ts` — Background tasks & autonomous agent (**TIDAK** di-export dari index.ts — import langsung: `@lembaran/core/Sentinel`)
- `Linguis.ts` — AI translation (Gemini)
- `Pundi.ts` — Zustand global store
- `Laras.ts` — Context/path resolver (Node-only, dynamic import)
- `storage/BrowserAdapter.ts` — IndexedDB adapter
- `storage/FileAdapter.ts` — JSON file adapter (Node.js)

## Rules Penting untuk AI

### Import Sentinel
```typescript
// ✅ BENAR (CLI only)
import { Sentinel } from '@lembaran/core/Sentinel';

// ❌ SALAH — menyebabkan node:child_process masuk browser bundle
import { Sentinel } from '@lembaran/core';
```

### Gunakan i18n navigation (bukan next/link langsung)
```typescript
// ✅ BENAR — locale-aware
import { Link, useRouter, usePathname } from '@/i18n/navigation';

// ❌ Hindari di halaman [locale] — tidak locale-aware
import Link from 'next/link';
```

### Locale di komponen client
```typescript
// Ambil locale saat ini
import { useLocale, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
const locale = useLocale(); // 'id' | 'en'
const t = useTranslations('NamaNamespace');
```

### Environment Variables
- `.env` ada di **root monorepo** — Next.js membacanya via `dotenv` di `next.config.ts`
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — untuk AI translation (Linguis/PenyaringRahasia)
- `DB_PATH` — path custom untuk FileAdapter (CLI)

## Dev Commands
```bash
bun run dev      # Start dev server di port 1400 (auto-kill port dulu via predev)
bun run build    # Sync aset + next build
bun run lint     # ESLint semua package (web + core + cli)
```

## Konvensi Penamaan
Seluruh kode menggunakan **bahasa Indonesia** untuk identifier:
- `Arsip` = Archive/Notes manager
- `Brankas` = Vault/Crypto engine
- `Gudang` = Storage
- `Pundi` = Store (Zustand)
- `Laras` = Context resolver
- `Sentinel` = Background task manager
- `Linguis` = AI translator
- `Pujangga` = AI provider manager

## Halaman (app/[locale]/)
| URL | Halaman |
|-----|---------|
| `/id/` atau `/en/` | Landing page |
| `/id/pustaka` | Daftar catatan (main app) |
| `/id/catatan/[id]` | Editor catatan |
| `/id/bantuan/[slug]` | Dokumentasi (markdown) |
| `/id/laras` | Pengaturan |
| `/id/jatidiri` | Profil |
| `/id/cari` | Pencarian |
| `/id/versi` | Changelog |
| `/id/tentang` | Tentang |
| `/id/privasi`, `/id/ketentuan` | Legal |
